paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἀπῆλθον εἰς ἄλλον τόπον τῆς γῆς, καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι ὄρος πυρός, ὃ νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ἀνῆπτεν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai ekeithen apēlthon eis allon topon tēs gēs, kai edeixen moi oros pyros, ho nyktos kai hēmeras anēpten.

i18n.en: And from there I went to another place of the earth, and he showed me a mountain of fire, which burned night and day.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐπορεύθην πρὸς αὐτὸ καὶ εἶδον ἑπτὰ ὄρη ἔνδοξα, πάντα τὰ μὲν διαφέροντα ἀλλήλων, λίθων ἐντίμων καὶ ὡραίων, ἔνδοξα ἐν εἴδει καὶ ὡραῖα τὴν ὄψιν· τρία πρὸς ἀνατολὰς ἓν ἐπὶ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἐστηριγμένον, καὶ τρία πρὸς νότον ἓν ἐπὶ τοῦ ἑνός, καὶ φάραγγες βαθεῖαι, μήτε ἐγγίζουσαι ἀλλήλαις.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eporeuthēn pros auto kai eidon hepta orē endoxa, panta ta men diapheronta allēlōn, lithōn entimōn kai hōraiōn, endoxa en eidei kai hōraia tēn opsin; tria pros anatolas hen epi tou henos estērigmenon, kai tria pros noton hen epi tou henos, kai pharanges batheiai, mēte engizousai allēlais.

i18n.en: And I went toward it and saw seven glorious mountains, all differing from one another, of precious and beautiful stones, glorious in appearance and lovely to look upon — three toward the east, one founded upon another, and three toward the south, one upon another, and deep ravines between them which did not approach one another.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἕβδομον ὄρος ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶν, ὑπερεῖχεν αὐτοῖς ἐν ὕψει, ὅμοιον καθέδρᾳ θρόνου, καὶ ἐκύκλουν αὐτὸ δένδρα εὐώδη.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hebdomon oros ana meson autōn, hypereichen autois en hypsei, homoion kathedra thronou, kai ekykloun auto dendra euōdē.

i18n.en: And there was a seventh mountain in the midst of them, exceeding them in height, like the seat of a throne; and fragrant trees encircled it.

paragraphs.commentary: Enoch's tour reaches the central seventh-mountain — the throne-of-glory mountain. The cosmography integrates the cosmic-mountain tradition (the seven mountains of 1 En 18) with the throne-vision tradition (1 En 14) and the tree-of-life tradition (1 En 25). See central entries `seven-mountains-of-god-1-enoch-18-24-cosmic-mountain-cluster-extension-cross-corpus` and `tree-of-life-1-enoch-24-25-gen-2-9-rev-22-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐν αὐτοῖς ἦν δένδρον τοιοῦτον οἷον οὐ ἐγὼ οὔπω ὠσφράνθην, καὶ οὐδὲν ἕτερον ἦν αὐτοῦ ὅμοιον· ὀσμὴν ἦν εὐωδέστατος πάντων εὐωδῶν, καὶ τὰ φύλλα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ ἄνθος καὶ τὸ ξύλον οὐδέποτε ξηραίνεται· ὁ καρπὸς αὐτοῦ ὡραῖος, ὁ καρπὸς αὐτοῦ ὅμοιος βότρυσιν φοίνικος.
paragraphs.translit: Kai en autois ēn dendron toiouton hoion ou egō oupō ōsphranthēn, kai ouden heteron ēn autou homoion; osmēn ēn euōdestatos pantōn euōdōn, kai ta phylla autou kai to anthos kai to xylon oudepote xērainetai; ho karpos autou hōraios, ho karpos autou homoios botrysin phoinikos.

i18n.en: And among them was a tree such as I had never smelled, and none other was like it; its fragrance was sweeter than every fragrance, and its leaves and flower and wood never wither; its fruit is beautiful, its fruit like the clusters of a date palm.

paragraphs.commentary: The fragrant tree on the throne-of-glory mountain — the **tree of life** of the 1 Enoch tradition, whose perfume is 'unlike any other perfume' and whose fruit is reserved for the eschatological-righteous-elect. The cosmography is the Second-Temple-Jewish development of the Gen 2:9 + Gen 3:22-24 tree-of-life motif: the Hebrew Bible barring becomes the apocalyptic-eschatological-restoration. See central entry `tree-of-life-1-enoch-24-25-gen-2-9-rev-22-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: Τότε εἶπον· Ὡς καλὸν τὸ δένδρον τοῦτο καὶ εὐῶδες, καὶ ὡραῖα τὰ φύλλα, καὶ τὰ ἄνθη αὐτοῦ ὡραιότατα.
paragraphs.translit: Tote eipon; Hōs kalon to dendron touto kai euōdes, kai hōraia ta phylla, kai ta anthē autou hōraiotata.

i18n.en: Then I said: How beautiful is this tree, and how fragrant; and lovely are its leaves, and its flowers most lovely.

paragraphs.text: Τότε ἀπεκρίθη μοι Μιχαὴλ, ὁ εἷς τῶν ἁγίων ἀγγέλων ὁ μετ' ἐμοῦ ὤν, καὶ αὐτὸς αὐτῶν ἡγεῖτο.
paragraphs.translit: Tote apekrithē moi Michaēl, ho heis tōn hagiōn angelōn ho met' emou ōn, kai autos autōn hēgeito.

i18n.en: Then Michael, one of the holy angels who was with me, and he was leading them, answered me.
